episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-29016

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.intent: Rename a key that upstream renamed inside an ignored local override config file, preserving the file's ignored and untracked state.

postconditions.description: No ignored config-like file still contains an old key from the renames mapping.
postconditions.name: no_old_keys_in_ignored_config
postconditions.probe:
renames=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)renames[^/]*\.conf$' | head -n1)
[ -n "$renames" ] || exit 1
stale=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  case "$f" in
    config/*|*.conf|*.ini|*.cfg) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r old new; do
    [ -n "$old" ] || continue
    if awk -v old="$old" '
      {
        eq=index($0,"=")
        if (eq == 0) next
        key=substr($0,1,eq-1)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", key)
        if (key == old) { found=1; exit }
      }
      END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
    ' "$f"; then
      stale=1
    fi
  done < <(awk '
    /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
    /^[[:space:]]*$/ { next }
    {
      eq=index($0,"=")
      if (eq == 0) next
      old=substr($0,1,eq-1); new=substr($0,eq+1)
      gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
      gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
      sub(/[[:space:]]+#.*$/, "", new)
      if (old != "" && new != "" && old != new) printf "%s\t%s\n", old, new
    }
  ' "$renames")
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n')
[ "$stale" -eq 0 ]
